usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, exchange rates (foreign currency per pula), 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: USD 0.0743 per pula, i.e. about 13.46 pula per US dollar (1/0.0743); World Bank 2025 average 13.50.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 2.3 annual inflation (Statistics Botswana CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Headline CPI up 7.8% year on year in September 2026 after 9.3% in August; above the Bank of Botswana's 3-6% objective range since early 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Botswana 3-6% inflation objective; CPI averaged about 5.9% a year over 2021-2025 (BEFS table 2.3)
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has run near the top of the 3-6% objective range over five years (12.2% in 2022, 2.7-2.8% in 2024-2025, 7.8% in September 2026), so 5% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Monetary Policy Rate (interest rates page)
policy_rate.note: MoPR 5.50% on 30 October 2026; raised from 3.50% in April 2026 (BEFS table 4.1).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 interest rates (commercial bank savings accounts)
savings_account_rate.note: Simple average savings-account rate of commercial and merchant banks, 2.10% in August 2026 (2.09% in July).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 interest rates (fixed deposits up to 12 months)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Average rate on pula fixed deposits up to 12 months, 4.21% in August 2026; the Bank of Botswana does not publish a separate 3-month figure (notice deposits 3.79%).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 interest rates (fixed deposits up to 12 months)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average rate on pula fixed deposits up to 12 months, 4.21% in August 2026 (4.28% in July); fixed deposits over 12 months averaged 3.65%.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found in Bank of Botswana statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Botswana
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.35% average for 2024 (older than 2025); the Bank of Botswana publishes only simple averages by deposit type (fixed up to 12 months 4.21% in August 2026).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government bonds and treasury bills are auctioned by the Bank of Botswana.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026 (3-month bill BOTSTB0227)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average yield of winning bids 5.655% on the 3-month bill maturing 3 February 2027 (stop-out effective yield 5.878%); 5.881% at the 24 September auction.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026 (bond BOTSGB0931, maturing September 2031)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average yield 7.22% on the 7.75% bond maturing 10 September 2031 (about 4.9 years).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026 (bond BOTSGB0635, maturing June 2035)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Weighted average yield 9.02% on the 8.60% bond maturing 6 June 2035 (about 8.6 years), the closest line to 10 years; the 2040 bond yielded 10.88%.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Botswana, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest paid to residents is subject to 10% withholding tax, which is final; interest from a Botswana bank or building society is exempt up to BWP 7,800 a year.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of government bond interest for individuals is not stated by PwC or another source read.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Deposit Insurance Scheme of Botswana: establishment
deposit_insurance_limit.note: The scheme guarantees up to P250,000 per depositor per member institution; established under the Bank of Botswana (Amendment) Act 2022, regulations in force since 21 July 2023 (date of the rule, still current).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate was found; the Bank of Botswana publishes the prime lending rate (7.19%) and average return on advances (16.2% in August 2026) only.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.5 Botswana Stock Exchange
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the domestic company index barely rose over ten years, so equities may return little more than their dividends.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.5 Botswana Stock Exchange; treasury bill and deposit rates
equity_return_base.note: Base case: the domestic company index rose only about 1.8% a year from December 2016 (9,401) to September 2026 (11,250) plus dividends of about 5-8%, so equities are put about 2 points above the after-tax 1-year bill yield (about 5.8%), below the 4-point cap.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.5 Botswana Stock Exchange
equity_return_high.note: High case: a strong decade for local shares or a global index fund in pula terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Botswana exchange rates (pula per US dollar)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a small pula depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Botswana exchange rates; World Bank official exchange rate history
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus about 1.5% a year of pula depreciation under the crawling basket peg.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and a weaker pula.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 (notice deposits 3.79%, savings 2.10%)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: notice and savings deposits, with the first P7,800 of interest tax free and 10% withholding above it.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 (fixed deposits up to 12 months 4.21%)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 12-month fixed deposits at 4.21%, mostly untaxed for a small saver (P7,800 exemption, 10% above).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 12-month treasury bills (6.46%) or 5-year bonds (7.22%) less 10% withholding tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: NBFIRA (the insurance regulator) publishes no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no published premium rates per 1,000 pula of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Botswana was found; public hospital care is heavily subsidised.

health_premium_table.note: No published private medical aid contributions by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Botswana
oop_health_share.note: 4.3% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 2.4 cost of living index by group (health)
goal_inflation_health.note: The health price index rose only about 2.2% a year from December 2016 to September 2026 because public care is subsidised, but private medical costs rise faster, so 0.5 points above the 5% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 2.4 cost of living index by group (education)
goal_inflation_education.note: The education price index rose about 3.4% a year from December 2016 to September 2026, below general inflation (4.9%); private school fees are assumed to rise with the 5% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Botswana

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.38 (2025, World Bank), 8.7 (2040) and 20.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/botswana/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: Botswana has no public contributory pension and no statutory pension age for private employees was found; retirement ages are set by employers' pension fund rules.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Botswana Public Officers Pension Fund, member information
retirement_age_government.note: Normal and compulsory retirement age for public officers is 60; early retirement from 45. Up to half of the benefit can be taken as a tax-free lump sum, the rest buys an annuity.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 (notice and savings deposits)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: notice and savings deposits after the 10% withholding tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1 (fixed deposits up to 12 months 4.21%)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: 12-month fixed deposits (4.21%), little taxed for a small saver; below the after-tax 1-year treasury bill yield (about 5.8%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in treasury bills or short government bonds after 10% tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Botswana Economic and Financial Statistics, September 2026, table 4.1
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026; equity base 8%; gold base 5.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of government bonds, equity (local and global) funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Botswana, Government bond and treasury bill auction results, 30 October 2026; equity high 11%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: A universal non-contributory Old Age Pension Scheme exists (named in the 2026/27 Budget Speech), but no official current monthly amount could be read; the government social protection page could not be loaded (expired certificate).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The Old Age Pension Scheme exists (2026/27 Budget Speech), but its eligibility age and rules could not be read from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: The Employment Act provides a severance benefit, but its text could not be read from an official source, so the days per year of service are not given.

public_pension_scheme.note: Botswana has no public contributory pension: 'There are no social security taxes or contributions in Botswana' (PwC Tax Summaries, reviewed 9 January 2026). Old age is covered by the universal non-contributory Old Age Pension and employer pension funds; public officers belong to a defined-contribution fund (BPOPF).

fdr_3m.note: Banks offer fixed deposits of 3 to 12 months; the central bank publishes one average for terms up to 12 months.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: 3, 6 and 12-month bills auctioned monthly by the Bank of Botswana for the government.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned monthly by the Bank of Botswana and listed on the Botswana Stock Exchange.

tbond_10y.note: Lines maturing 2035, 2040, 2043 and 2050 are on issue.

equity_fund.note: Supervised by NBFIRA; local funds invest on the Botswana Stock Exchange and abroad.

gold.note: No local bullion product is sold; gold is bought as jewellery or imported coins.
